svg.title: Fig. 4 | Fracture and injury risk after starting enzyme-inducing and individual antiseizure medications
svg.text: Each medication vs levetiracetam, lamotrigine, or lacosamide, days 31–730
Bars show the 95% CI on a log scale from 0.3 to 3.3; tick, 1.
Lacosamide vs levetiracetam: published signal and reconstructions
Shaded band and dashed blue line: 95% CI and point estimate of the published study.
Outcome in every row: hip, cervical vertebra, or forearm fracture.
